title: The Perfect Hash Filter: An Efficient Implementation of the Positive Bernoulli Set and Bernoulli Map
description: Final version (October 2026), with errata; superseded by the monograph Bernoulli Types: Two-Sided Error in Approximate Membership, Retrieval, and Computation, Chapter 15. The perfect hash filter (PHF): the minimal-perfect-hash-plus-fingerprint filter described by Dietzfelbinger and Pagh (2008), restated as a positive Bernoulli set and map, about log2(e) bits per element above the bound, with a corrected k-perfect false-negative analysis.
